text: The Cambodia National Action Plan on Drought Management and Adaptation (2025–2030) is a strategic initiative aimed at transitioning Cambodia from reactive drought response to proactive risk management. It integrates forecasting, early warning, governance, infrastructure, and community-level adaptation to address the increasing frequency, severity, and duration of droughts in Cambodia due to climate change. The plan is structured around six pillars: governance and institutional coordination, risk assessment and planning, forecasting and early warning systems, climate-resilient policies and infrastructure, capacity development, and financing alignment.
